tasks.title: Add the export error codes and the pure file-name rules (Source name, suggested name, extension match)
tasks.dod: Vitest proves sourceNameOf/exportFileName apply all six AC-07 steps and the fallback, matchesExtension accepts exactly the AC-01b extensions in any case, and result.ts carries the four EXPORT_* codes

tasks.title: Add the pure size, quality and default-format rules (presets, long side, half-up rounding, snapping)
tasks.dod: Vitest proves normalizeQuality, exportSize/normalizeLongSide (integer half-up, 0.5 px bound, AC-06 snaps incl. 4096x10 -> 205x1) and defaultFormat against the AC-04/05/06/19 rules

tasks.title: Carry Source name, Source format and the transparency fact on the Work from every open
tasks.dod: Vitest proves every open (Open image and drop, incl. replace) sets Work.sourceName/sourceFormat from the new file and Original.hasTransparency from the worker alpha scan; open-and-view tests stay green

tasks.title: Add the editor store's exclusive exporting phase, beginExport/finishExport and the save point
tasks.dod: Vitest proves beginExport/finishExport: only finishExport(saved=true) moves cleanRevision to the snapshot revision (AC-09/10), and opens, drops (with notice) and edits are refused during exporting while View actions work (AC-11)

tasks.title: Extract the shared shader module and build the export worker that renders, flattens, encodes and verifies one export
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the export worker handler renders with the shared shaders, flattens only JPEG onto white, returns a content-verified Blob or EXPORT_FAILED / EXPORT_FORMAT_MISMATCH, and always closes the bitmap; preview-renderer tests stay green

tasks.title: Add the once-per-session format check and the main-thread export client (worker spawn, transfer, terminate)
tasks.dod: Vitest proves checkExportFormats judges JPEG/WebP by sample content (false on any error, PNG always true) and exportImage transfers the bitmap, maps worker crashes to EXPORT_FAILED and terminates the worker every time

tasks.title: Add the platform save path: Save as… dialog, verified write, empty-target removal and the download hand-off
tasks.dod: Vitest proves pickSaveTarget (single-type filter, cancelled/activationLapsed/picked), writeFile (EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED + abort), discardEmptyTarget (remove where present, never throws) and downloadFile (named link, URL revoked after 60 s)

tasks.title: Create the export store: panel state, defaults, session memory, format availability and the messages catalog
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the export store applies AC-19 defaults and session memory, starts the format check once on first open without ever switching the selected format, falls back to PNG on disableFormat, and derives dimensions, suggested name, transparency hint and path line

tasks.title: Orchestrate the export in the export store: snapshot, encode, Save as… or download, refusals, File ready, save point
tasks.dod: Vitest drives confirm() through save, download, cancel, File ready, EXPORT_FAILED, EXPORT_FORMAT_MISMATCH, EXPORT_EXTENSION_MISMATCH and EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED, asserting the save point, notices, panel state and that nothing is written after a render or format failure

tasks.title: Add the Popover and SegmentedControl shared primitives and register them in the design system
tasks.dod: Component tests prove Popover (non-modal, Escape/outside close unless locked, focus in and back) and SegmentedControl (radiogroup, arrow keys skip disabled, hints); both registered in docs/design-system.md

tasks.title: Add the NumberField and SliderField shared primitives (apply on blur and Enter, apply-now) and register them
tasks.dod: Component tests prove NumberField normalizes on blur, Enter (no submit) and exposed apply(), and SliderField keeps range and number in step; both registered in docs/design-system.md

tasks.title: Build the export panel (SCR-03) in every state on the export store and the new primitives
tasks.dod: Component tests prove ExportPanel renders every SCR-03 state from screens.md, applies pending field values before confirm or close, never exports on Enter in a field, and is locked during an export except in File ready

tasks.title: Mount the Export action in the editor top bar with its states, the Ctrl/Cmd+S shortcut and the exporting lock
tasks.dod: Component tests prove Export is keyboard-reachable, Ctrl/Cmd+S follows every screens.md keyboard row (never the browser Save page), and Open image/Export are disabled with progress during exporting; App mounts ExportAction through the top-bar slot

tasks.title: Precache the export worker and prove export works offline after the first load
tasks.dod: e2e/export/offline.spec.ts passes on Chromium and Firefox: sw.js precaches the export worker, and an export after going offline and reloading produces a file whose content matches its format

tasks.title: Write the functional e2e suite: format honesty, fidelity, quality and size, naming, metadata, downloads and Save as…
tasks.dod: pnpm test:e2e passes e2e/export formats, fidelity, quality-size and naming-metadata specs on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit: content matches the extension, full-size PNG is within 2/255 of the Preview at 100%, sizes and dimensions follow AC-04/05, and no metadata survives

tasks.title: Write the @perf export suite: export time p95, longest freeze and memory after 10 exports
tasks.dod: PERF=1 e2e/export/perf.spec.ts on the reference machine shows export p95 <= 1 s (JPEG q90) and <= 2 s (PNG) for 4096x3072, longest long task <= 200 ms, and memory after 10 exports <= 110% of after the first
